text:
maria_sales: Kickoff POC w/ Acme Health tomorrow — quick sync in thread on scope + integration checklist. They care about streaming chat, server-side auth (enterprise), explicit rate limit SLAs, and an eval plan to measure hallucination. Can we confirm SDK streaming examples, expected quotas, and recommended retry/backoff? cc @alex_eng @pat_ml :calendar: 

alex_eng: Happy to. Short list: 1) SDK streaming (WS or HTTP/2) supported in our JS and Python SDKs. 2) Auth: API key for hosted, mTLS or customer-managed KMS for Private. 3) Quotas: we can set per-key RPS + token caps. Will paste a tiny JS snippet for streaming.

alex_eng: ```js
// streaming example (node)
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-ml-1', messages: [...] });
for await (const chunk of stream) { process.stdout.write(chunk.delta); }
```

pat_ml: For success criteria from ML side — suggest: 1) latency p50 < 200ms, p95 < 600ms for common prompt set; 2) semantic recall on labeled eval set >= 85%; 3) no PII exfil in outputs (we'll run regex detectors). Also need ability to pin model version.

maria_sales: Timeline: 2-week POC. Week 1: integration + auth + streaming smoke tests. Week 2: run eval prompts, monitor latency/cost, iterate. Are those success criteria realistic?

jamie_se: Realistic. A few operational notes: - Recommend start with 2 concurrent workers hitting streaming endpoint to validate concurrency. - Set quota: 60 rps by default for POC, adjustable. - Use exponential backoff (base 200ms, max 10s) with full jitter for retries. Include idempotency keys for non-streaming requests.

alex_eng: On quotas — we can create a temporary rate-limit profile named `acme-poc` with: {"rps": "60", "burst": "120", "token_month": "10M"} (we'll provision higher if needed). Ops bot will create the profile after approval.

dev_ops_bot: @maria_sales Requested quota profile `acme-poc` created (id: q-8f3d). Current limits: 60 rps, burst 120, monthly token cap 10,000,000. To increase, file request in #eng-infra or reply here.

pat_ml: Security checklist question from Acme: can we support customer-managed keys for model logs and a retention policy? Also need SSO for access to the console and audit logs.

jamie_se: Yes — Private deployments support KMS/HSM for at-rest encryption and optional log redaction. For Hosted we offer encryption at rest and allow export to customer's S3 with server-side encryption. SSO (SAML) + role-based access is available for enterprise teams.

maria_sales: Good. For integration handoff, Alex — can you attach the minimal SDK snippet + recommended env vars to the shared doc? Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/POC-Acme-integration (internal).

alex_eng: Done — added a short README with: auth flows, streaming example, recommended headers (X-Redwood-Idempotency, X-Client-Version), and retry guidance.

pat_ml: We'll prepare a 100-prompt eval set and a smaller prompt bank for latency testing. Will upload to the doc by EOD.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll send the POC kickoff invite and include the Acme security contacts. Last open question: SLA for 99th percentile during POC? Ops — can we commit to a target for this short window?

dev_ops_bot: For POC we can commit to a best-effort 99th < 1s on dedicated capacity. For hosted tier it's best-effort; if they need strict SLA we should consider Dedicated for the POC.

jamie_se: Recommend offering Dedicated trial for the POC if Acme needs firm SLA. Otherwise set expectations — hosted can fluctuate under load.

maria_sales: Ok — I'll clarify with Acme and update the doc. Thanks everyone — will report back after kickoff. :thumbsup:
